claims.quote: There will people in America and its possessions by the lapse of another century.
claims.description: The US and its possessions will hold five hundred million people by 2001.
claims.stated_time: by the lapse of another century

claims.quote: Nicaragua will ask for admission to our Union after the completion of the great canal. Mexico will be next.
claims.description: Nicaragua, Mexico and other Latin American republics will be voted into the US as states.

claims.quote: The American will be Taller by from one to two inches.
claims.description: Average American height will increase one to two inches due to health reforms.

claims.quote: He will live fifty years instead of thirty-five as at present —for he will reside in the suburbs.
claims.description: Average lifespan will rise to fifty years, with most people living in suburbs.

claims.quote: The city house will practically be no more. Building in blocks will be iNegal.
claims.description: City houses and block building will vanish, replaced by suburban living.

claims.quote: The trip from suburban home to office will require a few minutes only. A penny will pay the fare.
claims.description: Commuting from suburb to office will take minutes and cost a penny.

claims.quote: There will be No C, X or Q in our every-day alphabet.
claims.description: The letters C, X and Q will be dropped, with phonetic spelling adopted first by newspapers.

claims.quote: english will be a language of condensed words expressing condensed ideas, and will be more extensively spoken than any other. Russian will rank second.
claims.description: English will be the most spoken language and Russian second.

claims.quote: Hot or cold air will be turned on from spigots to regulate the temperature of a house as we now turn on hot or cold water from spigots to regulate the temperature of the bath.
claims.description: Central plants will pipe heated or cooled air to houses, like utilities (central heating and air conditioning).

claims.quote: Homes will have no chimneys, because no smoke will be created within their walls.
claims.description: Homes will have no chimneys as heating becomes smokeless.

claims.quote: Mosquitoes, house-flies and roaches will have been practically exterminated.
claims.description: Mosquitoes, flies and roaches will be nearly exterminated through drainage and chemical treatment, making screens unnecessary.

claims.quote: Food will be served hot or cold to private houses in pneumatic tubes or automobile wagons.
claims.description: Ready-cooked meals will be delivered from wholesale cooking establishments to homes, with dishes returned for washing (food delivery).

claims.quote: Such wholesale cookery will be done in clectric laboratories rather than in kitchens.
claims.description: Cooking will be done in electric facilities with electric appliances such as dish-washers, egg-beaters and potato-mashers.

claims.quote: Having one’s own cook and purchasing one’s own food will be an extravagance.
claims.description: Home cooking and private food purchasing will become an extravagance.

claims.quote: Liquid-air refrigerators will keep great quantities of food fresh for long intervals.
claims.description: Liquid-air refrigeration will preserve food for long periods.

claims.quote: Coal will Not be Used for Heating or Cooking.
claims.description: Coal will be abandoned for heating and cooking as electricity becomes cheaper.

claims.quote: The earth’s hard coal will last until the year 2050 or 2100; its soft-coal mines until 2200 or 2300.
claims.description: Hard coal supplies will be exhausted by 2050-2100 and soft coal by 2200-2300.

claims.quote: Every river or creek with any suitable fall will be equipped with water-motors, turning dynamos, making electricity.
claims.description: Widespread hydroelectric generation on rivers and creeks.

claims.quote: Along the seacoast will be numerous reservoirs continually filled by waves and tides washing in.
claims.description: Tidal and wave power reservoirs along coasts will generate electricity.

claims.quote: There will be No Street Cars in Our Large Cities.
claims.description: Street cars will vanish, with hurry traffic moved to subways or elevated trestles.

claims.quote: These underground or overhead streets will teem with capacious automobile passenger coaches and freight wagons, with cushioned wheels.
claims.description: Automobile buses and trucks will use grade-separated roads in cities.

claims.quote: Cities, therefore, will be free from all noises.
claims.description: Cities will become free from noise.

claims.quote: If there be a battle in China a hundred years hence snapshots of its most striking events will be published in the newspapers an hour later.
claims.description: Photographs will be telegraphed over any distance, appearing in newspapers within an hour.

claims.quote: Photographs will reproduce all of Nature’s colors.
claims.description: Color photography will reproduce all natural colors.

claims.quote: Trains will run two miles a minute, normally ; express trains one hundred and fifty miles an hour.
claims.description: Electric trains will normally run 120 mph and express trains 150 mph, with New York to San Francisco in a day and a night.

claims.quote: There will be cigar-shaped electric locomotives hauling long trains of cars.
claims.description: Electric locomotives of streamlined shape will haul trains, with no smoke or cinders.

claims.quote: Cars will, like houses, be artificially cooled.
claims.description: Railway cars will be air-conditioned.

claims.quote: Automobiles will have been substituted for every horse vehicle now known.
claims.description: Automobiles will replace all horse-drawn vehicles including farm machinery, ambulances, hearses and street sweepers.

claims.quote: A onepound motor in one of these vehicles will do the work of a vair Of horses or more.
claims.description: A one-pound motor will do the work of a pair of horses.

claims.quote: A manor woman unable to walk ten miles at a stretch will be regarded as a weakling.
claims.description: Universal compulsory exercise and gymnasiums will make walking ten miles normal.

claims.quote: Fast electric ships, crossing the ocean at more than a mile a minute, will go from New York to Liverpool in two days.
claims.description: Electric ships traveling over 60 mph will cross the Atlantic in two days.

claims.quote: The bodies of these ships will be built above the waves. They will be supported upon runners, somewhat like those of the sleigh.
claims.description: Ships will ride on runners above the water, reducing friction (hydrofoil-like craft).

claims.quote: Upon their under sides will be apertures expelling jets of air. In this waya film of air will be kept between them and the water’s surface.
claims.description: Ships will use air lubrication films under the hull to reduce drag.

claims.quote: In storm they will dive below the water and there await fair weather.
claims.description: Ocean liners will submerge to avoid storms.

claims.quote: There will be Air-Ships, but they will not successfully compete with surface cars and water vessels for passenger or freight traffic.
claims.description: Airships will exist but will not compete commercially with surface transport, used mainly for war and scientific observation.

claims.quote: Giant guns will shoot twenty-five miles or more, and will hurl anywhere within such a radius shells exploding and destroying whole cities.
claims.description: Long-range artillery with 25-mile range will destroy entire cities.

claims.quote: Fleets of air-ships, hiding themselves with dense, smoky mists, thrown off by themselves as they move, will float over cities, fortifications, camps or fleets.
claims.description: Aerial war fleets will bomb enemies from the air under smoke screens.

claims.quote: Huge forts on wheels will dash across open spaces at the speed of express trains of to-day.
claims.description: Armored mobile land fortresses (tanks) will charge at high speed.

claims.quote: Great automobile plows will dig deep intrenchments as fast as soldiers can occupy them.
claims.description: Motorized plows will dig trenches rapidly for armies.

claims.quote: Rifles will use silent cartridges.
claims.description: Rifles will fire silently.

claims.quote: Submarine boats submerged for days will be capable of wiping a whole navy off the tace of the deep.
claims.description: Submarines will operate submerged for days and be able to destroy entire navies.

claims.quote: Balloons and flying machines will carry telescopes of one-hundred-mile vision with camera attachments, photographing an enemy within that radius.
claims.description: Aerial reconnaissance photography from aircraft with powerful telescopic cameras.

claims.quote: There will be No Wild Animals except in menageries.
claims.description: Wild animals will survive only in captivity, and rats and mice will be exterminated.

claims.quote: The horse will have become practically extinct.
claims.description: Horses will nearly disappear, kept only by the rich for sport.

claims.quote: Cattle and sheep will have no horns.
claims.description: Livestock will be bred hornless and optimized to produce meat, milk and wool.

claims.quote: Persons and things of all kinds will be brought within focus of cameras connected electrically with screens at opposite ends of circuits, thousands of miles at a span.
claims.description: Live remote video transmission to theatre screens, with synchronized sound (television).

claims.quote: Wireless telephone and telegraph circuits will span the world.
claims.description: Worldwide wireless telephony and telegraphy, including intercontinental and ship-to-shore calls.

claims.quote: By an automatic signal they will connect with any circuit in their locality without the intervention of a ‘* hello girl.’’
claims.description: Automatic telephone switching will replace human operators.

claims.quote: Grand Opera will be Telephoned to private homes, and will sound as harmonious as though enjoyed from a theatre box.
claims.description: Live opera and music will be transmitted by telephone to private homes with high fidelity.

claims.quote: Great musicians gathered in one inclosure in New York will, by manipulating electric keys, produce at the same time music from instruments arranged in theatres or halls in San Francisco or New Orleans, for instance.
claims.description: Musicians will remotely play instruments in distant cities via electric keys, enabling long-distance concerts.

claims.quote: Automatic instruments reproducing original airs exactly will bring the best music to the families of the untalented.
claims.description: Automatic instruments will reproduce music exactly (recorded music playback).

claims.quote: A university education will be free to every man and woman.
claims.description: Free university education for all, with national universities.

claims.quote: Medical inspectors regularly visiting the public schools will furnish poor children free eyeglasses, free dentistry and free medical attention of every kind.
claims.description: Schools will provide free medical, dental and vision care to poor children, plus free lunches and transport.

claims.quote: Pneumatic tubes, instead of store wagons, will deliver packages and bundles.
claims.description: Pneumatic tube networks will deliver store purchases and mail to homes over hundreds of miles, supplemented by automobile distribution.

claims.quote: He will also grow large gardens under glass. At night his vegetables will be bathed in powerful electric light, serving, like sunlight, to hasten their growth.
claims.description: Farmers will use electric soil heating and artificial lighting to grow crops year-round (greenhouse and grow-light agriculture).

claims.quote: Electric currents applied to the soil will make valuable plants grow larger and faster, and will kill troublesome weeds.
claims.description: Electricity applied to soil and seeds will boost plant growth and kill weeds.

claims.quote: Fast-tlying refrigerators on land and sea will bring delicious fruits from the tropics and southern temperate zone within a few days.
claims.description: Fast refrigerated transport will bring out-of-season fruit from the southern hemisphere.

claims.quote: Delicious oranges will be grown in the suburbs of Philadelphia.
claims.description: Plant breeding will allow oranges to grow in Philadelphia.

claims.quote: Strawberries as Large as Apples will be eaten by our great-great-grandchildren for their Christmas dinners a hundred years hence.
claims.description: Selective breeding will produce giant fruit such as apple-sized strawberries and orange-sized cranberries.

claims.quote: Melons, cherries, grapes, plums, apples, pears, peaches and all berries will be seedless.
claims.description: All major fruits will be bred seedless.

claims.quote: Peas and beans will be as large as beets are to-day.
claims.description: Peas and beans will be bred to the size of beets.

claims.quote: The milkweed will have been developed into a rubber plant.
claims.description: Milkweed will be bred into a domestic rubber crop harvested by machinery.

claims.quote: Plants will be made proof against disease microbes just as readily as man is to-day against smallpox.
claims.description: Plants will be immunized against disease microbes.

claims.quote: The soil will be kept enriched by plants which take their nutrition from the air and give fertility to the earth.
claims.description: Nitrogen-fixing plants will maintain soil fertility.

claims.quote: There will be black, blue and green roses.
claims.description: Flowers will be bred to any color, including black, blue and green roses, and giant sizes.

claims.quote: It will be possible to grow any flower in any color and to transfer the perfume of a scented flower to another which is odorless.
claims.description: Perfume will be transferable between flowers, with any flower in any color.

claims.quote: Drugs needed by the lungs, for instance, will be applied directly to those organs through the skin and flesh. They will be carried with the electric current applied without pain to the outside skin of the body.
claims.description: Drugs will be delivered through the skin by electric current to target organs, avoiding swallowing.

claims.quote: Not only will it be possible for a physician to actually see a living, throbbing heart inside the chest, but he will be able to magnify and photograph any part of it.
claims.description: Invisible-ray imaging will make the living body transparent so physicians can view and photograph organs.
